title: Metering Service Referee Refund Settlements and Bills After the Company Test
content:
A **Metering Service** referee refund settlement may reach bills of the Electric Service Agreement that ended after the company test date, according to the meter installation's status and removal date.

**Clause.** Where the meter was removed from service after the company test date, the referee refund settlement also reprices the regular bills whose billing period ended after the company test date and on or before the removal date, added to the bills counted back from the company test date, because the meter kept registering fast until it was taken out. Where the meter is still in service, the referee refund settlement also reprices every regular bill whose billing period ended after the company test date, added to the bills counted back. In every other case, a meter removed on or before the company test date among them, no bill whose billing period ended after the company test date is added.

## Cases (hypothetical, company test on 9 January, monthly bills ending on the 20th)

| Installation record | Bills ending after 9 January that are added |
|---|---|
| Removed 25 February | Those ending 20 January and 20 February |
| Removed 15 February | Only the bill ending 20 January |
| Removed 9 January | None |
| In service, handling date 5 April | Those ending 20 January, 20 February and 20 March |
